policy_context_checks.question: Descriptions establish sale or consumption; the prohibition and its applicability are supplied by offline labels citing Sec 44, rather than stated in the description. Confirm that fixed policy is represented internally.
Descriptions establish attire; the applicable apron or clothing requirement is supplied by offline labels citing Sec 49. Confirm the internal policy and covered activities.
Descriptions establish carrying or storage; offline labels supply the uncovered-carrying or locked-storage requirement citing Sec 55. Confirm the internal policy and relevant exceptions.
Offline labels supply specific dwelling, animal or children rules citing Sec 43, 45 and 46b. Confirm those internal policies and the boundary with Stall Occupancy.
Descriptions establish absence of a grease trap; offline labels supply its requirement citing Sec 50. Confirm applicability and category mapping internally.
Descriptions establish an expired extinguisher; unlike the other extinguisher examples, these do not explicitly state the vendor duty. Confirm the fixed safety duty internally.

Descriptions establish hawking with no mobile vendor ID on record; offline labels infer lack of vending authorization citing Sec 42 and 61. Confirm that equivalence and the boundary with Vendor Identification internally.

interpretation: These 44 label occurrences are policy-context checks, not 44 proven annotation errors. Offline section citations have not been independently verified. Gold remains unchanged in every metric. Policy context should be maintained internally; no additional runtime user fields or approval steps are proposed.
